title: Better Than Coal
description: A Small Mod Adding 2 New Tiers of Coal.
body:
A Small Mod Adding 2 New Tiers of Coal That Have Longer Burn Time, I Might add more features to this in the future But it was just meant to be a test while i figured out how to make my first mod.

Added Items/Blocks So Far:
- Nether Coal, Charcoal and Coal Block
- Blaze Coal, Charcoal and Coal Block
  
![The types of coal and charcoal added to the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/136c15173095f0ad8538a1074ba3193317ff6120.png)

This Mod Was Made with use of MCreator
